history.prediction_scored: partial. The registered pooled statistic for cohorts 2010-2017 was 0.734 (95% CI 0.727-0.741, n=15,224), which falls between the support (>=0.75) and refute (<0.65) thresholds. It is pulled down by cohorts 2010 (0.29) and 2011 (0.59) only because the legacy CO table (bs8b-p36w) begins in July 2012, so COs issued before then are missing; this was a named alternative ('CO records missing from open data'). The Housing Database, named in the plan as the second measure, gives 0.83-0.88 for the same 2010-2011 cohorts and 0.76-0.88 for 2010-2021. Cohorts 2012-2021 on the DOB measure lie between 0.74 and 0.85; pooled 2013-2017 is 0.807 (0.799-0.814). The verdict 'confirmed' therefore rests on a cohort restriction chosen after the data were seen, for a documented reason, and supported by the independent HDB measure. The registrant's own expectation (about 0.70) was too low. Median time from first NB permit to first CO was 1.97 years for 2013-2017 (Furman: about 1.9). Eventual completion (CO by Nov 2026) for 2012-2017 cohorts is 0.91-0.93, below Census's near-complete national figure.
